2607.29355.title: Cross-Lingual Transfer for Machine Translation in Turkic Languages
2607.29355.paper_summary: Cross-lingual transfer is central to low-resource machine translation, but its behavior within closely related language families remains insufficiently characterized. We study transfer among five Turkic languages; Turkish, Azerbaijani, Uzbek, Kazakh, and Kyrgyz; using pairwise transfer matrices. In this setting, each model is fine-tuned with one transfer source and evaluated on a different transfer target while the translation target remains the same. Across mT5 experiments, we find that transfer is strongest between closely related Turkic pairs, especially Turkish-Azerbaijani and Kazakh-Kyrgyz. We also show that transfer direction matters, and that the same transfer source-transfer target pair can behave differently when the translation target changes. Latinization improves BLEU and chrF in several script-mismatched settings, but its effect is not uniform across metrics. Additional analyses show that transfer sources are mostly stable across different datasets and model settings.
2607.29355.paper_summary_zh: 跨語言轉移是低資源機器翻譯的核心，但其在密切相關語言家族中的行為仍然不足以被充分描述。我們研究了五種突厥語言之間的轉移；土耳其語、阿塞拜疆語、烏茲別克語、哈薩克語和吉爾吉斯語；使用成對轉移矩陣。在這個設定中，每個模型都使用一個轉移來源進行微調，並在不同的轉移目標上進行評估，而翻譯目標保持不變。在 mT5 實驗中，我們發現轉移在密切相關的突厥語對之間最強，特別是土耳其語-阿塞拜疆語和哈薩克語-吉爾吉斯語。我們還顯示了轉移方向的重要性，同一轉移來源-轉移目標對在翻譯目標變化時可能會有不同的表現。拉丁化在幾個腳本不匹配的設定中改善了 BLEU 和 chrF，但其效果在不同指標間並不均勻。額外的分析顯示，轉移來源在不同數據集和模型設定中大多是穩定的。
